name: Rastland Nassereith
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Rastland Nassereith in Nassereith**

Discover the heart of the **Zillertal** in **Nassereith**, where the **Rastland** invites you to relax and enjoy the stunning Alpine scenery. Whether you're stopping for a break on your journey or seeking a peaceful retreat, this charming spot offers a perfect blend of nature, comfort, and local hospitality.

Indulge in traditional Tyrolean dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Kaspressknödel**, or a warm bowl of **Käsespätzle**, paired with a refreshing **Zillertaler** beer or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner**. The cozy atmosphere and panoramic views of the surrounding mountains make every visit unforgettable.

Take a moment to recharge your batteries, explore the scenic trails, or simply soak in the tranquility of the **Tiroler Alps**. The **Rastland Nassereith** is your ideal stopover between **Innsbruck** and the breathtaking landscapes of the **Zillertal Valley**.

**Come and experience the warmth of Tyrol!**
